concerns.text: FR-003 (Phase‑Locking Value) is required by the specification but no task implements PLV computation; the only related tasks (T024, T026) address Spectral Density Correlation (SDC) after a spec amendment (T032). Until the spec is officially changed, the original PLV requirement lacks coverage.

Constitution III (Data Hygiene) mandates that downloaded MEG and CLUTRR datasets be checksummed and the checksums recorded in the project state file. No task in the list generates or records SHA‑256 checksums for these datasets.

Constitution IV (Single Source of Truth) requires every figure or statistic in the final paper to trace back to a unique data row and code block. No task explicitly creates or validates this traceability linkage.

Constitution V (Versioning Discipline) requires that every generated artifact have its content hash stored in the project’s state YAML. The current task set does not include any step that records these hashes after artifact creation.
